claims.title: Delivery milestone
claims.text: In this fictional scenario, Gridworks has energized its first facility. Customer acceptance and billing have not yet begun.
claims.thesis_impact: Energization reduces one execution risk, but it does not establish utilization, revenue or cash returns.

claims.title: Utilization outlook
claims.text: Fictional management expects 75–85% utilization next quarter; this is guidance, not a reported result.
claims.thesis_impact: Compare future actual utilization with this dated forecast.

theses.name: Nova Compute — fictional
theses.thesis: Scarce compute may generate recurring cash flow if utilization supports replacement costs.
theses.bear: Pricing falls before equipment is paid back; financing dilutes owners.
theses.base: Utilization improves while funding remains available; returns depend on entry price.
theses.bull: Contracted demand and disciplined capacity growth improve cash flow per share.
invalidation: Utilization persistently misses the stated range
unknowns: Current valuation relative to cash flow
assumptions: No fresh investment recommendation is possible from synthetic prices.

theses.name: Gridworks — fictional
theses.thesis: Energized infrastructure may earn durable returns if contracts cover financing and maintenance.
theses.bear: Customer ramp slips while interest and construction costs rise.
theses.base: Billing begins after acceptance; capital returns remain to be demonstrated.
theses.bull: Reliable delivery supports repeat contracts and better financing terms.

opportunities.reason: Illustrates a research candidate outside the current infrastructure theme. No verified valuation or recommendation.
